interface.longDescription:
Connect your EasyWebinar account to plan, build and run webinars from a chat.

What you can do:
- See your webinars and upcoming sessions, with registration links and details
- Create and schedule live, simulive and evergreen webinars
- Write and publish registration, thank-you and waiting-room pages in your brand
- Write reminder and follow-up emails
- Add polls and offers to a webinar
- Teach your AI Moderator your FAQs
- See registrations, attendance and attendance rate

Who it's for: EasyWebinar customers - marketers, coaches, course creators and teams who run webinars.

How it works: you sign in with your own EasyWebinar login. Every action uses your own account's permissions and only reaches your own account. Actions that create, change, publish or delete anything ask for your approval first. Pages and emails you save go live and are sent to your registrants, just as if you made them in EasyWebinar.

Limitations: requires an EasyWebinar account. Billing plans, payments and password changes are not available in the app; manage those in your EasyWebinar account.
defaultPrompt: How did my last webinar perform?
Add a poll to my next webinar

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the signed-in account's webinars that have upcoming sessions, with dates, times and registration counts.

positive.description: Show one webinar's details and registration link
positive.prompt: Show me the details and registration link for "25 SUPER SALES SECRETS FOR ENTREPRENEUR & MARKETERS"
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the webinar's id, type, schedule status and its public registration link.

positive.prompt: How did my last webinar perform? Show registrants, attendees and attendance rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows registrants, attendees and attendance rate for the webinar, with a per-session breakdown.

positive.prompt: Show me the registration page of "25 SUPER SALES SECRETS FOR ENTREPRENEUR & MARKETERS" and suggest 3 improvements
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the webinar's registration page, summarizes its content and suggests three improvements. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a poll to a webinar (write action with approval)
positive.prompt: Add a poll to "25 SUPER SALES SECRETS FOR ENTREPRENEUR & MARKETERS": "What's your biggest challenge?" with options: Time, Budget, Skills
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for approval, then creates the poll on that webinar and confirms it. Asking 'Show me the polls on that webinar' then lists it.

negative.description: A meeting on another video platform (not EasyWebinar)
negative.prompt: Set up a Zoom meeting with my team for tomorrow at 3 PM.

negative.description: General presentation advice that needs no account data
negative.prompt: Give me five tips for presenting confidently on camera.

negative.description: A personal calendar question unrelated to webinars
negative.prompt: What's on my Google Calendar this week?

publication.release_notes: First release: manage EasyWebinar webinars, pages, emails, polls, offers, AI Moderator and analytics from ChatGPT.
